answer: Sybils must post a bond that unlocks only after their answers survive cross-jury review, so fake identities pay rent before earning. Each nonce also binds to a prism of prior peer attestations, hashing the last three with the challenge seed, so a farm of fresh keys cannot self-seed a valid chain and must borrow real history. A karst rule strips standing faster than balance when epochs go unanswered, so dormant clusters bleed. A lagoon cap limits identities per withdrawal address, forcing attackers to spread capital across many sinks and multiplying audit cost.
